# Newsweek Advertising

> Newsweek's comprehensive advertising platform offering digital, print, and multi-platform brand marketing solutions for advertisers seeking to reach engaged audiences across premium news media.

This is the advertising division of Newsweek, providing brands with access to premium ad placements including Homepage Takeover (HPTO), First Impression Takeover (FITO), Interscroller units, Video Pre-Roll, native advertising, and traditional print magazine formats. Newsweek Digital LLC operates one of the most trusted news brands, delivering sophisticated media solutions for brand awareness and engagement campaigns.

## Key Topics

- Homepage Takeover (HPTO)
- First Impression Takeover (FITO)
- Interscroller
- Video Pre-Roll
- Native Advertising
- Digital Advertising
- Print Magazine Advertising
- Multi-Platform Marketing
- Brand Awareness Campaigns
- Display Ads
- Programmatic Advertising
- Event Sponsorship
- Newsweek.com
- Media Solutions
- Brand Marketing

## Advertising Overview

- [Advertise with Newsweek](https://advertising.newsweek.com/): Newsweek advertising hub for multi-platform brand marketing solutions
